exposure: gestational age at induction of labor (41(+4)-42(+0) weeks vs 41(+0)-41(+3) weeks)
gestational age at induction of labor
outcome: composite outcome of need for comprehensive treatment at a neonatal department or neonatal death
cohort: Singleton births without major congenital malformations, with registered GA, and with intended vaginal delivery at GA 41(+0) - 42(+0) weeks between 2009 and 2018 in Denmark.
finding: Births at GA 41(+4)-42(+0) weeks were associated with an increased risk of neonatal morbidity (low Apgar score, meconium aspiration, need for respiratory support, comprehensive neonatal treatment or death) and birth complications (emergency cesarean section, severe lacerations, increased blood loss) compared to births at GA 41(+0)-41(+3) weeks.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section rates were higher in births at GA 41(+4)-42(+0) weeks compared to births at GA 41(+0)-41(+3) weeks.
